description: Is this error known? Paste an error message or stack trace (and optionally the library): it is cleaned of paths and line numbers, then searched in the library's own GitHub issues, all GitHub issues and Stack Overflow, returning the best matches with status (closed, accepted answer...), links and excerpts. For a likely fix use /error/explain. Price: $0.005 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). In the free trial.

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem: npm, pypi, crates (Rust) or go (Go modules).

library.description: The package the error comes from, to search its own issues first.

message.description: The error message (a stack trace is fine; paths and line numbers are stripped).

name: error-known

relevance.description: Share of the error's words found in the match (0-1).

status.description: open / closed / accepted answer / answered / unanswered.

query.description: The cleaned-up phrase that was searched.

title: Error known ($0.005)
